XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for UCKK Archive activity module

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive
TABLE.COMMENT: UCKK archive activity instances.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle course id for the activity instance.

FIELD.NAME: allowpublicitems
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether public archive items are allowed.

FIELD.NAME: completionrequireitem
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion requires at least one item.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_item
TABLE.COMMENT: Archive items stored by the activity.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary user id for the item.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_kristal
TABLE.COMMENT: Kristal records derived from or linked to archive items.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_proof
TABLE.COMMENT: Proof and evidence records linked to archive items.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_prov
TABLE.COMMENT: Provenance records for archive material.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_rev
TABLE.COMMENT: Revision history for archive items.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_export
TABLE.COMMENT: Archive export package requests and generated package records.

FIELD.NAME: redacted
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether restricted or personal data was redacted.

FIELD.NAME: fileitemid
FIELD.COMMENT: File API item id for generated package.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_external_work
TABLE.COMMENT: External works referenced by archive media and content advisories.

FIELD.NAME: creator
FIELD.COMMENT: Creator, author, director, or primary contributor.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_library
TABLE.COMMENT: Autonomous media libraries used by public Univers-Cité sites.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_library_site
TABLE.COMMENT: Maps public Univers-Cité site keys to one or more media libraries.

FIELD.NAME: sitekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Public site key such as uckk, ucc or math.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_media
TABLE.COMMENT: Media library records owned by the archive module.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_media_version
TABLE.COMMENT: Version records for archive media.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_media_source
TABLE.COMMENT: Source and provenance references for media records.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_media_collection
TABLE.COMMENT: Named media collections.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_media_collection_item
TABLE.COMMENT: Media collection membership records.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_library_bridge
TABLE.COMMENT: Directional sharing bridges between otherwise autonomous media libraries.

FIELD.NAME: sourcelibraryid
FIELD.COMMENT: Library that owns the exposed media.

FIELD.NAME: scopeid
FIELD.COMMENT: Collection/media id, or 0 for whole-library scope.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_media_relation
TABLE.COMMENT: Relations between media and archive/external targets.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_media_tag
TABLE.COMMENT: Media tag assignments.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_content_tag_set
TABLE.COMMENT: Reusable content advisory tag sets.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_content_tag
TABLE.COMMENT: Content advisory tag definitions.

FIELD.NAME: iscultural
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this is a cultural protocol tag.

FIELD.NAME: restrictsbydefault
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this tag restricts by default.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_content_tag_set_item
TABLE.COMMENT: Membership table between content tag sets and content tags.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_content_marker
TABLE.COMMENT: Content advisory markers on media, external works, or archive items.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_content_review
TABLE.COMMENT: Human review decisions for content advisory markers.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_kartifact
TABLE.COMMENT: Stable Kristal artifact identities stored by a media library without owning semantic content.

FIELD.NAME: kristalref
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable semantic Kristal reference owned by Kristal/Kristall.

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: University, voie, course, or generic artifact kind.

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Parent Kristal artifact in the no-overlap UCKK hierarchy.

FIELD.NAME: mediaid
FIELD.COMMENT: Médiathèque media row containing the current stored artifact.

TABLE.NAME: uckkarchive_kversion
TABLE.COMMENT: Immutable stored versions of Kristal artifacts linked to media versions.

FIELD.NAME: mediaversionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Immutable media version carrying artifact bytes.

FIELD.NAME: sha256
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of stored Kristal artifact bytes.
